spots.bio: Pinnaroo museum with engines, farm memorabilia, a working Letterpress Printing Museum and a 1000-variety grain collection.
spots.name: Mallee Tourist and Heritage Centre
spots.note: themurrayriver (two pages): Pinnaroo museum with engines, farm memorabilia, working Letterpress Printing Museum and a 1000-variety grain collection.

spots.bio: Guido van Helten's 2017 silo mural beside the Dukes Highway, with a picnic area, a free roadside stop.
spots.name: Coonalpyn Downs Silo Art
spots.note: themurrayriver Coorong page names the Coonalpyn silo art (Guido van Helten's mural on the Dukes Highway); a roadside icon travellers stop for.

spots.bio: Gentle bush-trail climb to a survey marker with views over Coonalpyn and farmland.
spots.name: Tauragat Hill
spots.note: SATC and themurrayriver: gentle bush-trail climb to a survey marker with views over Coonalpyn and farmland. Short visit; second-tier lookout.

spots.bio: Park around a 129 m granite and limestone outcrop, with spring orchids and Boothby Rocks picnic area; Tolmer Rocks is the same listing.
spots.name: Mount Boothby Conservation Park
spots.note: SATC and themurrayriver: named for a 129 m granite/limestone outcrop, spring orchids, Boothby Rocks Reserve picnic area. Case against: 4WD tracks, little infrastructure. Tolmer Rocks is the same SATC listing.

spots.bio: Malleefowl habitat with a 1.5 km, 45-minute Karte hike from the campground.
spots.name: Karte Conservation Park
spots.note: parks.sa.gov.au: 1.5 km (45 min) Karte hike from the campground with interpretive signs and district views, malleefowl habitat; open daily.

spots.bio: Large mallee wilderness, 4WD only, with 11 campgrounds and 10 walks including Box Flat ruins and Gosse Hill.
spots.name: Ngarkat Conservation Park
spots.note: parks.sa.gov.au: large mallee wilderness, 4WD only, 11 campgrounds and 10 walks (Box Flat ruins, Gosse Hill hike); also SATC.
